data.body_html:
Feria San Bernabe 2028 is Marbella's biggest annual celebration, running from 7 to 17 June. Thousands flock to the fairground for music, dancing, food, and carnival rides. But before the evening festivities begin, a yacht charter from Puerto Banús offers a stylish way to start the day. Our fleet of 17 boats, all departing from Puerto Banús, provides inclusive pricing with a skipper, drinks, and snacks — so you can relax and enjoy the Mediterranean.

Why Choose a Yacht Charter for Feria San Bernabe 2028?

The fairground is just a 5-minute drive from Puerto Banús. A 2-hour afternoon cruise gives you time to swim, sunbathe, and sip cava before heading to the fair. With prices starting at €749 for 2 hours on our Tier A boats, it's a cost-effective way to elevate your Feria experience. No hidden fees: everything is included.

Our Fleet: Best Boats for Groups of 5 to 12

We have boats for every group size. For 5 guests, the Dubhe (8m) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m) are nimble options. For up to 10, the Fairline Targa 12m or Pershing 46 offer speed and style. For 12 guests, choose the Mangusta 80 (24m) or Ferretti 94 (29m) — both with spacious decks and luxury interiors.

  • Tier A (€749/2h → €2,299/8h): Astondoa 40, Azimut 39 — ideal for small groups.
  • Tier B (from €4,719/4h): Mangusta 80 (white or grey) — includes free jet ski.
  • Other boats: Pricing on request via WhatsApp — from the Boat Rental Marbella fleet.

Sample Itinerary: Afternoon Cruise + Feria Evening

Depart Puerto Banús at 16:00 on the Azimut 39 (11 pax, €749/2h). Cruise south to Cala del Faro for a swim and snorkel. Enjoy chilled white wine and snacks on board. Return to port at 18:00, then take a short taxi ride to the fairground for the 19:00 opening. You'll have time for the fair's famous rebujito and flamenco shows.

What's Included in Every Charter

All our charters are all-inclusive. There are no surprise costs. You get:

  • Licensed skipper
  • Fuel
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (olives, crisps, nuts)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%)

Just bring sunscreen, swimwear, and your Feria spirit.

Book Early for Feria San Bernabe 2028

June is peak season in Marbella, and Feria week is especially busy. We recommend booking at least 4–6 weeks in advance. For Tier A and B boats, you can see pricing online; for larger yachts like the Canados 86 or Maiora 26m, contact us via WhatsApp for a personalised quote. We'll help you choose the perfect boat for your group.
